description.en:
Gives the player a coach (director) and makes it the team's coach, in one call: the coach item is added to the inventory, then equipped on team 0.

The player's data keeps four teams (team 0 plus three extra teams). By default only team 0 gets the new coach. Pass true as third argument to also set it on teams 1, 2 and 3.
Pass true as second argument to first take the coach currently set on team 0 out of the inventory, so the new one replaces it instead of adding to the collection.
true to remove team 0's current coach from the inventory before adding the new one.
true to set the coach on all four teams, false for team 0 only.

true once the coach has been added and set.
false if the ID argument is not a string, the item system is not ready, or the item could not be added.
null if the engine is not ready or no argument was given.

examples.case: Setting up the starting coach on every team (real usage, new-game setup)
Replacing the current coach on the main team
examples.code:
// Swap team 0's coach: the old one is taken out of the inventory.
CMND_ADD_SET_DIRECTOR("iim0002", true);
